positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: DocuSign helps organizations connect and automate how they prepare, sign, act-on, and manage agreements. As part of its cloud-based System of Agreement Platform, DocuSign offers eSignature—the world’s #1 way to sign electronically on practically any device, from almost anywhere, at any time.

positions.title: Solution Developer, Analyst
positions.description: As a solution developer at Avanade, I have the opportunity of working on a large client web application built in Angular 5. I am the development lead of the defects team and act as the point of contact between the onshore, client, and business development teams for day-to-day tasks. I also contribute to customer-facing meetings, send out daily status reports to management, provide root cause analysis of incoming defects, and review developers' pull requests on Bitbucket.

positions.title: Student Design Trainee I
positions.description: As a programmer on the application development team at the San Francisco International Airport (SFO), I designed and developed RESTful APIs and web services in production-level code utilizing a variety of technologies such as Java, Python3, and their frameworks Dropwizard, EclipseLink, Django, and Flask, just to name a few. I also participated in the full software development life cycle and designed database schemas, entity relationship diagrams, and sequence diagrams. At SFO, we participate in an Agile development process, use Jira for task tracking, and Jenkins for continuous integration.

positions.title: Student Technology Consultant
positions.description: As a Student Technology Consultant, I communicated technology solutions and workarounds to UC Merced professors and students in-person and through emails and ServiceNow ticketing system. I enforced IT and computer lab policies, managed over 50 computer stations, and provided software, hardware, and audiovisual support in over 60 classrooms and labs across campus.

positions.title: IT System Administrator Intern
positions.description: At Space Systems Loral, I utilized Microsoft's System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and System Center Service Manager (SCSM) to manage and maintain thousands of computer system endpoints and tracked daily software request tickets. I created and deployed silent install packages compatible with MS-DOS and managed a remediation project to mitigate vulnerabilities across all Windows systems on campus. I also analyzed statistical security scans and made recommendations on how to prevent susceptible 3rd party and Microsoft software from being attacked which improved system security for over 2000 users.

honors.title: Finalist in Civic Engagement - Mobile App Challenge 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: Executed a workshop with Kaiser Permanente's IoT team for United Fund's (UNCF) Historically Black Colleges and Universities' 2018 Innovation Summit. Assisted undergraduates in building their own chatbot using Google's AIY Voice Kits and Raspbery Pi. Introduced students to making API calls using Python.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Health Education Representatives for Opportunities to Empower Students (HEROES)
volunteerExperiences.description: Educated and trained in different health topics and collaborated with peer health group interns to encourage and spread the idea of making healthy life choices on and off campus.

company.name: Health Education Representatives for Opportunities to Empower Students (HEROES)

projects.title: Telephone Service Representative Web Application (Avanade)
projects.description: Developed UI layouts for a healthcare provider’s redesigned web application using TypeScript, Angular 5, PrimeNG, HTML, and CSS. Created directives for manual autofocus and application-specific keyboard navigation in tables, list boxes, and between modules. Analyzed and delegated tasks to two to seven team members and completed 10 - 30 defects weekly.

projects.title: Automobile Insurance Quoting Web Application (Avanade - Ignition Training)
projects.description: Built a web-based, data-driven auto insurance quoting application, integrating membership security model, an administrative interface, and industry-specific business logic. Participated in specification gathering and received client sign-off of our database schema and web application. Designed the application architecture and SQL Server data model based on client specifications. Utilized the latest Microsoft toolset including C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework Core, and Azure SQL Server and App Service. Co-led the backend team to ensure the product's completeness and usability by the four week deadline.

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Psi, Psi Upsilon Chapter
Society of Women Engineers
organizations.description: Worked with a team to recreate a webpage on Weebly (http://sweucmerced.weebly.com/) where students are able to access and learn more about the club, and kept site up to date to track progress of club. Introduced to HTML.
